headword: ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}

definitions.explanation: A novel or written work in the horror genre, intended to frighten or unsettle the reader.

examples.japanese: {寝|ね}る{前|まえ}にホラー{小説|しょうせつ}を{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read a horror novel before going to bed.

examples.japanese: このホラー{小説|しょうせつ}は{実話|じつわ}に{基|もと}づいている。
examples.english: This horror novel is based on a true story.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}のホラー{小説|しょうせつ}は{独特|どくとく}の{雰囲気|ふんいき}があり、{海外|かいがい}でも{翻訳|ほんやく}されて{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Japanese horror novels have a unique atmosphere and are popular overseas in translation.

notes:
A compound of the loanword ホラー (horror, from English) and {小説|しょうせつ} (novel). Japanese horror literature ({和製|わせい}ホラー or Jホラー) is known for its atmospheric, psychological approach, often drawing on traditional ghost stories ({怪談|かいだん}) and urban legends ({都市伝説|としでんせつ}). Notable authors include {鈴木光司|すずきこうじ} (Ring) and {小野不由美|おのふゆみ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}を{読|よ}む — to read a horror novel
- ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}{大賞|たいしょう} — horror novel award
- {日本|にほん}のホラー{小説|しょうせつ} — Japanese horror fiction
- ホラー{小説|しょうせつ}の{傑作|けっさく} — horror fiction masterpiece
